name: Cultist: Twilight Guardian adds a new shield to the remaining absorb without rescaling it (#12632)
contract: Twilight Guardian 704889 (aura 354, value 100, trigger 850002) reads: 'Damage dealt by Twilight Shieldtoss shields you for $s1% of the damage dealt for $850002d. Additional shields add to the remaining absorb amount and refresh its duration.' 850002 is SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB, SpellFamilyName 31, 8 s. AuraEffect::CalculateAmount multiplies every family-31 absorb a Cultist casts by GetTotalAuraMultiplier(SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_ABSORB_AMOUNT_PCT); In And Out of Insanity 582308 adds 20% with no class mask, so it scales 850002. The old hook re-cast 850002 with base points remaining + new, and the refresh ran the whole sum through that multiplier again, so each Shieldtoss hit grew the shield by 20% of everything left (#12632 reports billions). The fixture shield holds exactly 100000 remaining absorb; one Twilight Shieldtoss rank 804208 (level 18-24, EffectBasePoints 125 + DieSides 11, needs an equipped shield) against a passive dummy then adds 1.2 x its damage. Even a critical hit with this level-20 caster's spell power stays far below 1000 damage, so the additive result is bounded to (100000, 102000]; the old rescaled result is at least 120000. The refreshed duration must be back near 8 s after 2.5 s of the fixture's own duration ran out. spell_hit_rating 10000 removes the hit roll.

steps.label: SETUP: the fixture shield holds exactly 100000 absorb
Let part of the fixture shield's 8 s run out
The new shield adds to the remaining 100000 instead of rescaling it by 20% (#12632)
The added shield refreshes the duration
